narr: Along a stalled frontal over the eastern Piedmont of central North Carolina, isolated to scattered showers and storms developed in the afternoon and evening, mainly along and east of the US Highway 1 corridor. Storms over Wake County produced isolated flash flooding.
ev: A car was stranded in flood waters near the intersection of Hillsborough St. and Etta Burke Ct.
Raleigh police department closed interstate 440 eastbound due to flooding.
